chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked him about a man washing his wife; he said: "Yes, from behind the clothes."

key_terms.مِنْ وَرَاءِ الثِّيَابِ: from behind the clothes, indicating the stated manner or condition
key_terms.يُغَسِّلُ: to wash the body, in the context of funerary washing

ai.seo_question: Can a man wash his wife's body after death according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a husband washing his wife's body. It permits this act, with the condition that it be done from behind the clothes.
